items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Kenton had a way of being quite pretontious. I liked the man very much.

ctx.x: I think the pre-tention might have come from that side. I don't think it was on the writer's side so much.
Kenton had a way of being quite pretontious. I liked the man very much.
I think I hung onto that attitude for a long time, much longer than I should have, I suppose. Anyway, it was fun while it lasted.
